claim(uint256).details: Anyone can trigger payment; only the recorded topPlayer receives funds. Claims open at submissionDeadline(round) and close exclusively at that deadline plus CLAIM_GRACE. An unpaid winner, including an unpayable USDC recipient, leaves entrants eligible for individual entry-fee refunds after the window.

params.entryFee_: Entry fee denominated in USDC base units.
params.referee_: EOA whose signatures attest player scores.
params.usdc_: ERC-20 USDC contract used for every transfer.

enter().details: The caller must approve this contract for at least entryFee beforehand.

returns.bestScore: Highest accepted score for the player in the round.
returns.entered: Whether the player paid to enter the round.
returns.refunded: Whether the player's entry fee has been refunded.

returns.info: Round state with its entry and submission cutoffs.

refund(uint256).details: No-winner refunds open at the submission deadline. With an unclaimed winner, including an unpayable USDC recipient, refunds open at that deadline plus CLAIM_GRACE. Claimed rounds cannot be refunded; each entrant recovers only entryFee once.

params.round: Round from which to withdraw the caller's refund.

submitScore(uint256,uint32,bytes).details: Only improvements update personal bests; tied top scores keep the earlier leader. The inherited eip712Domain() exposes the domain fields used for signatures.

params.signature: Referee's ECDSA signature of the EIP-712 attestation digest.
